hero.label: Compliance
hero.title: Built for Regulatory Clarity
hero.desc: CCASH provides a compliance framework designed from the ground up to meet regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

features.title: KYC/KYB Verification
features.text: Identity verification with tiered KYC levels. Identity verification, source of funds, and accreditation checks built into every onboarding workflow.

features.title: Policy Framework
features.text: Comprehensive compliance policies covering customer identification, due diligence, transaction monitoring, and reporting obligations.

features.title: Multi-Jurisdiction
features.text: Legal opinions and compliance frameworks covering US, EU, UK, and emerging markets. Clear operator eligibility by jurisdiction with entity structure support.

features.title: Documentation
features.text: Standardized compliance documentation including policies, procedures, risk assessments, and reporting templates reviewed by legal counsel.

info_blocks.title: Compliance Infrastructure
items: Identity Verification: Multi-level KYC with operator certification
Jurisdictional Controls: Automated geo-blocking and eligibility enforcement
Transfer Restrictions: Smart contract enforcement of transfer rules
Reporting: Automated regulatory reporting and operator communications
Audit Trail: Complete transaction history for regulatory inquiries

cta.title: Questions About Compliance?
cta.text: Our team can walk you through the compliance framework and how it applies to your specific situation.
